تتبحبحن (form IIq)
# تَتَبَحْبَحْنَ (tatabaḥbaḥna) /ta.ta.baħ.baħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تُتَبَحْبَحْنَ (tutabaḥbaḥna) /tu.ta.baħ.baħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
